description:
Search providers

Searches existing Reclaim providers by domain or data point. A provider is the recipe an end-user follows to prove something about themselves, such as a follower count or an order history. Call this before create_provider — most popular domains already have one.

items.description: A free-form label attached to an entity for grouping and filtering in listings. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character; only ASCII letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens are allowed between.

name: providers
